title: typikon product
description: Frontmatter contract for a product page (content/products/<slug>.md). Requires price, Stripe checkout URL, and shipping note so the product page renders the full purchase block.

audience.description: Intended buyer or reader context for the product page.

price.description: Display price with optional leading $ (e.g. '$150', '85'). Bare number assumed USD.

price_source.description: Source for the rendered price claim, e.g. the Stripe price object, SKU ledger, or fixture note.

stripe_url.description: Stripe direct-checkout URL. Generated in the Stripe dashboard per product.

shipping_note.description: Override the default shipping line. Defaults to 'Shipping included · Tax at checkout · Ships within one week'.

availability.description: Schema.org Offer.availability state. Emitted in JSON-LD only alongside availability_source; never defaulted to InStock.

availability_source.description: Source for the availability claim, e.g. inventory count or a manual stock check. Required alongside availability.

images.description: Product photography. First image becomes the hero (eager-loaded); the rest lazy-load. Files live under static/<src>; Zola's resize_image() generates 400/800/1200px WebP variants automatically. The og_image field is independent — typically points at the same hero shot or a 1200x630 social-card variant.

src.description: Path under static/ (e.g. 'img/products/belt/01.jpg'). Camera-native formats (heic, tiff) accepted as input; resize_image converts to WebP.

alt.description: Accessible description. Describe what's in the photo for visitors who can't see it.

caption.description: Optional figcaption rendered under the image.
